notes:
- New add-on Fit to send: shrinks photos and videos so they surely fit Discord, e-mail and other limits (editable presets), removes EXIF/GPS, puts the result on the clipboard. Videos use FFmpeg, downloaded on first use. Turn it on in Settings › Add-ons
- Export images is now Image converter 2.0: 13 formats (WebP, JPEG, PNG, GIF, ICO with many sizes, DDS, TGA, QOI, TIFF, EXR, HDR, BMP, PPM), file size before saving, resizing and "Convert to ›" in the right-click menu
- Upscale: Balanced and Best quality work – one job per model at a time, and when the graphics card returns a broken result, smaller tiles or the CPU are used automatically
- Add-ons: new APIs for images (fit, convert, estimate), video (FFmpeg: probe, encode) and copying files to the clipboard
